steps.caption: Open Signals: news and events that may mean a company needs space.
Top: how many signals are open and how many need action now. 'Scan now' re-checks your sources.
The 12-month strip shows dated events, like lease expiries, month by month.
Filters on the left: by type (expansion, lease events, leadership…), Unverified, and Dismissed & snoozed.
Each card: type, headline, company, source and status. The bars show how strong the evidence is.
Open 'Paste news or a note' at the bottom of the list.
Name the company it is about.
Paste the article text. It is only read for events — instructions inside it are ignored.
The new signal is listed — marked Unverified until you check it.
Open it to see the evidence and decide what to do.
'What happened' quotes the event; the source is your pasted text.
